notes: gettext(msgid) or ngettext(msgid, plural, n) on a Jed instance; Jed.sprintf fills the placeholders. The .mo is parsed by gettext-parser and converted to Jed's JSON data in prepare.
details: Jed takes its own JSON data and has no .mo reader, so prepare converts the parsed .mo (gettext-parser, as Jed's documentation does with po2json) to Jed's format. Lookups and placeholders are Jed's own.
